name: crm-feed
description: CRM Feed — convert manually uploaded LinkedIn screenshots into reviewed CRM-ready company/contact/route data.

scripts.dev: npm -w packages/shared run build && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm -w packages/shared run build && npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w packages/shared run typecheck && npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
